reasons.claim: No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

One eligible species, the VU lichen Collema subnigrescens, was recorded 977 m from the polygon edge (2025, 10 m uncertainty). Its Red List threats include lack of continuity forest. No eligible species within 250 m.
The NT fungus Artomyces pyxidatus was recorded 970 m away. It is a supporting record only, not eligible under the rubric.
Nothing recorded inside the polygon or within 250 m, but effort there is zero records. The 1000 m effort is low (6 records, 12th percentile, county median 66).

uncertainties: Both threatened-species records are near the 1000 m edge of the ring and come from a single observation day, so they may say little about the stand itself.
Low effort around the site means the lack of near-site records is weak evidence.
not_established: That the VU lichen or the NT fungus occurs on the felling site.
That the site lacks species or habitat values.
next_action: Have a reviewer check the stand for old-forest or continuity-forest features and for habitat of the lichen recorded ~1 km away. A field survey would help, since the site has had little recording.
